purpose: Replace the blocked Lambda cleanup guard with one named Step Functions Standard execution using native SDK integrations and an absolute expiry timer
limitations: The graph fixture evaluates real JSONata with controlled transport and clock; it is not an AWS emulator or deployed IAM proof.
Actual guard deployment, observed durable timer and terminal AWS resource inspection remain required before workload admission.
The existing regional Lambda concurrency quota and functions are unchanged; no Support or quota request is needed by this workflow.
Workflow deadlines and best-effort failure delivery do not constitute a hard billing cap. Fresh cost admission remains required within the approved additional $10 budget.
The full workload demo, retained-data acceptance and production feature enablement remain separate gates. Real two-account manual sharing/revocation testing stays deferred.
EC2 group replacement has no compare-and-swap; the exclusive worker and ENI leases must exclude concurrent network writers.
